1672 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year).  
249 days before 09-09-1672:  
Back up 9 days to 08-31-1672 (9 days).  
Back up 240 more days (total 249):  
August has 31 days, so 31 days back from 08-31 is 08-01 (31 days).  
Remaining 209 days (240 - 31 = 209).  
Go back into 1671 (not leap, 365 days): 209 days before 01-01-1672 is 1671-06-??  
From 01-01 back 209 days: June has 30 days, July 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31.  
Count backward: Jan 1 → Dec 1 is 31 days (Jan 1 to Dec 2 is 30 days? Let's count precisely).  

Better: 209 days before Jan 1, 1672 = 1671-06-06? Let's check:  
From 1671-06-01 to 1671-12-31 = 214 days (June 30, July 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31: 30+31+31+30+31+30+31=214).  
We need 209 days before Jan 1, 1672 = Jan 1 minus 209 days = 1671-06-06 (since 214 days from June 1 to Dec 31, so June 1 is 214 days before Jan 1; June 6 is 209 days before Jan 1).  

Thus 249 days before 09-09-1672 = 1671-06-06.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1671-06-06
